profile_text: As a specialist in property administration, this Düsseldorf-based firm provides tailored real estate management services, catering to the unique needs of its clients. Despite a recent decline in employee numbers, its 'Gazelle' category status indicates a history of rapid growth, driven by its expertise in navigating Germany's complex property market. With a focus on delivering personalized solutions, the company aims to rebound and regain its momentum in the real estate sector.
